metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the self-contained C++20 CLI in [output/](/workspace/output/README.md). It inspects ISO 2709 and MARCXML, renders both formats, validates UTF-8 and embedded MARC field rules, and returns structured errors.

Build from `output/` with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`. The clean build passed, as did ISO 2709 and MARCXML round trips and representative malformed-record checks.
